description: Multilingual TTS (10 languages). Preset voices with a style instruction, a voice designed from a description, or voice cloning from a reference clip (a 3 s clip is enough).
cpuNote: Slow on the CPU (float32). Upstream documents GPU use only; the 0.6B models are the practical choice.

settings.label: Voice
settings.description: Ignored when the speaker has a reference clip (cloning).

settings.label: Instruction
settings.description: Preset voice: speaking style, e.g. "Calm, warm storytelling." (1.7B only). Designed voice: describes the voice, e.g. "Elderly man, deep gravelly voice, slow pace." Not used for cloning.

settings.label: Reference transcript
settings.description: Cloning: the exact words spoken in the reference clip. Improves similarity; leave empty to clone from the voice timbre only.

settings.label: Model size
settings.description: 0.6B is faster but has no style instructions. Designed voices always use 1.7B.
